feature.label: Discord Presence & Chat for Eclipse IDE
feature.description:
Show what you are working on in Eclipse on your Discord profile, and keep Discord open in an Eclipse view.
- Rich Presence: "Playing Eclipse IDE" with the file you are editing, the project, a language icon, elapsed time, debugging state and an optional View Repository button. Works with no setup; every line of text and image is configurable. - Discord view: Discord's own web client in a workbench view, with an offline page when Discord can't be reached.
Requires Java 21 and the Discord desktop app. Forked from discord-vscode by Noel Buechler and contributors. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Discord or the Eclipse Foundation.
